decisions.question: When does the public repository get the steps to use 7 findings: now, or after their fix is in production?
decisions.options: public-now (each issue has the full detail, and apps/lab/audit goes to the branch with the lab when the audit ends; the minimal option) | after-fix (the issues and pull requests of the 7 findings name the change, the file, and the lines only; the lab goes to the branch when the audit ends without apps/lab/audit; that folder and the detail follow after the fixes are in production and the UPDATE of D-AUTH-05 ran) | after-fix-with-advisory (as after-fix, plus the detail in one private draft security advisory of ariakit/visonaut) | after-fix-no-issue (as after-fix for the folder, and no issue names the 7 findings before the deploy)
decisions.recommended: after-fix. Reason: holding the steps costs little (7 findings, settled fixes of effort S), and a published issue or a pushed commit cannot be taken back. Wrong if you judge that the public code and the ratings (2 medium, 5 low, no way from a caller with no credential to private data) make the full text harmless: then public-now is simpler and is the practice of the 20 earlier issues. Also wrong if a person or an agent on another computer must do these fixes: then after-fix-with-advisory.
